title: Repeated stages move earlier post-gate time into before-gate time
detail: The stage row sums every active segment, but after_gate_min uses only the latest gate close. Earlier decision-to-next-dispatch intervals become before_gate_min. A real archived repair cycle loses 23.2 post-gate minutes; a clean two-cycle fixture expects 20/20/40 but prints 50/20/10.
fix: Compute and sum before/wait/after per active dispatch interval; retain separate diagnostic treatment for incomplete historical records. Do not change accepted counter definitions.
released_user_and_normal_workflow: First Officer reads an archived task that was revised and dispatched again, using the documented timeline command.
observable_harm: Waiting after an earlier Captain decision is attributed to time before the gate, corrupting the approved split used to improve agentic DX.
affected_boundary: value-ac[AC-1] accurate per-stage timing under the accepted Design PRFAQ before-gate / Captain-wait / after-gate definitions
